entries.description: An intentional community and cooperative welcoming new members, girl children, boy children, and non-lesbian women, as well as dogs sometimes.
entries.raw_text: ARADIA INC MARIE CURIE TASK FORCE PO Box 7516, Grand Rapids, MI 49507. We are interested in, among other things, womyn's land. As individuals and severals we own land. We welcome: new members, girl and boy children, nonlesbian women (womyn born only), dogs sometimes. We are: 95% lesbians, 5% nonlesbians, inactive group with hopes to revive.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative because they state 'As individuals and severals we own land' and seek new members. Accepted groups include girl and boy children (from 'girl and boy children') and non-lesbian women (from 'nonlesbian women'). Lesbian women are not coded because the issue is a lesbian directory. Males are not coded because editor rules for 1982 state not to assume males are welcome unless specifically named, and 'womyn born only' restricts gender.

entries.description: A backpacking experience and retreat space for women to connect with nature.
entries.raw_text: WOMEN'S WILDERNESS EXPERIENCE/Jeanie Mudd, PO Box 4681, Santa Fe, NM 87502 (505)983-1175. An organization designed for women so that they might have closer contact with the land. WWE wants to show women a way to be with nature, that is not intimidating nor fearful, yet physically challenging. It is a backpacking experience.
entries.notes: Type is Retreat/Gathering Space based on 'backpacking experience' and organizing ways for women to be in nature. Focus is Workshops/education because it aims to 'show women a way to be with nature... physically challenging'. Accepted groups list is empty because specific groups are not named beyond general women.

entries.description: A project compiling stories, photos, and interviews about lesbian land across the US.
entries.raw_text: LESBIANS ON LAND Joyce Cheney, 78 Monroe St, Burlington, VT 05401. I'm compiling stories of lesbian land. Format: Chapters about several lesbian lands across the US, each chapter with photos, drawings, and transcriptions of taped interviews. I'm looking for a woman or women from some part of the herstory of each women's land, who will collect stories of that land. Process is participant controlled: You'll decide whether to use false or real names and locations, and what stories to include. They're your stories! Please write!
entries.notes: Type is Private/Individual Land by default for an individual contact collecting stories. Focus is Archives/cultural work based on 'compiling stories of lesbian land' and collecting herstory.

entries.description: A large intentional community welcoming lesbians, non-lesbian women, children (maybe), and males on 400 acres with residences, shops, and farm land.
entries.raw_text: OAKYNWOMYN Twin Oaks Community, Louisa, VA 23093. We are a large community of women and men looking for more lesbians and wimmyn-oriented-wimmyn. By our behavior we strive to eliminate the attitudes and results of sexism, heterosexism, racism, ageism and competition. Bring no pets. NO DRUGS! We welcome: new members/residents, children (maybe), lesbians, nonlesbian women, males. We have/are: 4 lesbians, 65 nonlesbians, 400 acres, housing/permanent structures (residences, shops, garage, etc), plumbing/electricity, camping space (visitors have rooms), woods, farm land.
entries.notes: Notes beginning 'NOT WOMEN\'S LAND' or similar are not strictly triggered here because LC lists them as welcoming lesbians. Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative. Acreage is 400. Num residents is calculated as 4 + 65 = 69. Accepted groups include non-lesbian women ('nonlesbian women'), girl and boy children ('children (maybe)'), and gay men and non-gay men ('males').

entries.description: A pacifist musical craftspeople simple lifestyle community on 7 acres welcoming children, lesbians, non-lesbian women, and males.
entries.raw_text: FAR AWAY FARM Rt 7 Box 279, Sparta, TN 38583 (615)277-3854. Pacifist musical craftspeople in simple lifestyle promoting spiritual power and androgynous philosophy. Short visits welcome with advance notice. No TV. Pets under strict supervision only. No hard drugs, others with our knowledge. We welcome: children, lesbians, nonlesbian women, males, dogs. We have: 7 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity, camping space, woods, farm land.
entries.notes: Type is Intentional Community/Cooperative based on 'musical craftspeople in simple lifestyle'. Acreage is 7. Accepted groups include girl and boy children ('children'), non-lesbian women ('nonlesbian women'), and gay and non-gay men ('males').
